title: Nine Feet of Slate
subtitle: 黑板与课堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 黑板与课堂（生活与学习·学校与课堂）
meta: 主题语境：黑板与课堂（生活与学习·学校与课堂）　|　核心词汇：blackboard　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 blackboard 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 my mother was sent to clean ① a blackboard she could not reach, and she said the reaching was the whole of the lesson. The ② blackboard, meaning the board and not the writing, was nine feet wide and was wiped by whoever came last; a blackboard, she said, is the only object in a school that is judged by how much has been removed from it.

Every ③ blackboard in that school had the same crack, and the ④ blackboard at the front, meaning the one the inspector stood at and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever washed properly. A blackboard, my grandmother said, is nine parts chalk and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the chalk is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ blackboard was the whole of the morning, meaning the writing and not the board. The ⑥ blackboard, meaning the lesson on it and not any of that, is the only thing in a room that everybody copies and nobody questions; a blackboard, he said, is either something you wipe or the only word that means both a board and a morning. She said the morning is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ blackboard had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the chalk dust. The ⑧ blackboard of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine feet of slate and eleven years of reaching; a blackboard, she said, is either the board at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ blackboard I remember is the one at the front, which was replaced in 1971 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ blackboard, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only object that improves by being wiped; every blackboard, she said, is a morning that has agreed to look like a board. She said the morning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 黑板（指那块板，与上面写的字相对）
C. 固定搭配：be sent to clean a blackboard 被派去擦黑板
D. n. 黑板（指那所学校每一块）
E. n. 黑板（指前面那一块）
F. n. 板书；黑板上的课（指那一上午的内容）
G. n. 板书（抽象：那一课这件事）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a blackboard she could not reach

answers.why: be sent to clean a blackboard 意为“被派去擦黑板”，1951 年母亲被派去擦一块她够不着的黑板。
blackboard 意为“黑板”，指那块板而不是上面写的字，它宽九英尺，由最后走的人擦。
blackboard 指那所学校每一块黑板，每一块都有同一道裂缝。
blackboard 指前面那一块（督学站的那一块），是唯一有人认真擦洗过的。
blackboard 意为“板书、黑板上的课”，指那一上午的内容，父亲说 blackboard 就是那个上午的全部。
blackboard 为抽象用法，指那一课这件事，是教室里人人都抄、却没人质疑的东西。
blackboard 意为“黑板”，到 1968 年这个 blackboard 成了报告里的一张照片。
blackboard 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英尺的石板和十一年的够取。
blackboard 意为“黑板”，我记得的是前面那一块，1971 年被换掉，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
blackboard 为抽象总称，祖母说黑板是唯一会因为被擦干净而变好的物件。
